title: Code and results: Deep sequence learning and gradient boosting for forecasting soil organic carbon change in Europe

creators.name: Hasan, Md Rakib

description: Analysis code, result tables, figures and run logs for a test of a convolutional-recurrent hybrid against gradient boosting for forecasting change in soil organic carbon on LUCAS topsoil points sampled in 2009, 2015 and 2018, under spatially blocked validation with hyperparameters selected inside each training fold. Version 2.0.0 adds nested hyperparameter selection, blocked early stopping, five-replicate robustness analysis with a mean-reversion floor, a forward-in-time design at points withheld in space, an ERA5-Land climate check, and a graph extension with an edge-free control. Version 2.1.0 adds paired block-bootstrap intervals for the graph extension and a test of whether the Landsat covariate series act as a proxy for the survey campaign. Version 2.2.0 adds stronger gradient-boosting baselines, with timing-aware features and nested hyperparameter selection, and a breakdown of skill by Köppen climate zone; 2.2.1 adds a check of that tuning with deeper trees, and 2.2.2 adds the ceiling on skill set by measurement noise, estimated from the covariance of successive changes at points sampled three times. The LUCAS source data and the panel derived from them are not redistributed, since their licence does not permit it; the code rebuilds the panel from files obtained directly from the European Soil Data Centre.
